description: A bright, classically composed transitional kitchen with a warm layered character. The cabinetry is painted a soft warm white-cream in Shaker inset profile, with some upper glass-fronted doors displaying stacked white ribbed dishware inside. The backsplash is thick book-matched white marble with soft gold veining, and the perimeter countertop matches. A large multi-pane double-hung window on the left wall floods the space with natural daylight. The herringbone-patterned hardwood floor in a warm honey-oak tone adds rich geometry underfoot. The kitchen island is clad in warm medium walnut wood paneling with a white marble top, seating three cushioned barstools with a barrel-back form in warm taupe fabric and natural wood legs. The island holds a round plate of mixed fresh fruit, a round cream ceramic vase with autumnal orange berry branches, and a small framed artwork leaned against the backsplash. Beside the sink, a small brass faucet and a bowl add styling. On the left near the window, a large fiddle-leaf fig in a white pot provides a lush vertical green element. A traditional Persian-style area rug in warm red, orange, and blue is positioned under and around the island. Brass cabinet hardware and a brass faucet carry the warm metal accent throughout. Warm golden glow washes down over the island in two overlapping pools from overhead. Camera is at standing eye-level, three-quarter view from slightly right of center, capturing the island, window wall, and full cabinetry.
